Holy Protection: Demonic enemies have Major Disadvantage when they Strike you.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.157
system.summary: Holy Protection: Demonic enemies have Major Disadvantage when they Strike you.

automation.note: Holy Protection: when a Demonic enemy Strikes you, the Director gives it Major Disadvantage (-1 Talent Die, or -2 Skill Dice if it has no Talent Dice; minimum 1 die).
